item.title: A coding agent’s harness can triple its cost without making it more accurate, study finds
item.description:
The harness surrounding an AI coding model — its system prompt, tools and context-management rules — can triple the cost of solving coding problems without producing a measurable improvement in accuracy, according to new research. AI vendors regularly advertise accuracy gains from harness updates. But whether a more elaborate harness actually makes an agent better at solving coding problems is less clear.
